hero.title: Pure gur from palm sap, straight to your home
hero.body: Our date palms grow in Tarash, Sirajganj. We boil the dawn sap into gur ourselves, and also sell honey and mustard oil.
hero.imageAlt: Rows of date palms beside a rice field

sap.title: From tree to gur
sap.intro: Nothing about how our gur is made is hidden. We show every step on video.

cut.title: Trimming the palm
cut.body: At the start of winter, the gachi shaves the top of each date palm to open a path for the sap.

collect.title: Bringing down the sap
collect.body: Sap fills a clay pot overnight, and the gachi brings it down at dawn.

boil.title: Boiling
boil.body: The fresh morning sap goes on the fire and slowly thickens.

make.title: Making gur
make.body: The thick sap becomes jhola, nali and patali gur.

farm.title: A farm of more than 100 date palms
farm.body: Our gachis climb before sunrise. Hear from the farm in this video.
farm.imageAlt: The farm's founder and a gachi beside the pond

steps.receive: We confirm by phone, and you pay when it arrives

about.title: Our story
about.lead: We work with more than 100 date palms in Tarash, Sirajganj, so that pure gur reaches your home this winter.
about.bannerAlt: The farm's vegetables, cows, date palms and gur
about.climbAlt: A gachi climbing a date palm behind the farm's founder
about.groveAlt: A row of date palms beside a rice field
about.gachiBody: Experienced gachis do everything from trimming the palm to bringing down the sap. We boil the dawn sap into gur ourselves.
about.openTitle: All of it in plain sight
about.openBody: We show trimming, collecting, boiling and making gur on video. You can follow along on our Facebook page.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Orders go out by courier. You will see the delivery charge for your area when you order. Pre-booked items ship once they are ready, and we call before sending them.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Pay the delivery person when your order arrives.

returns.title: Returns and problems
returns.body: Check your order when you receive it. If something is wrong, call us right away.

privacy.title: Your information
privacy.body: We take your name, mobile number and address for your order, and use them only to deliver it.
